question: list schools where actual applications received, fuzzy matched, fall short of half the expected number
gold_sql: WITH best AS (SELECT a."Applicant" AS applicant, o."School Name" AS matched_school, jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) AS sim FROM lpf_applications AS a JOIN lpf_outreach AS o ON jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) >= 0.9 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a."Applicant" ORDER BY sim DESC, o."School Name") = 1) SELECT o."School Name", COUNT(b.applicant) AS applications_received, o."Applications Expected" FROM lpf_outreach AS o LEFT JOIN best AS b ON b.matched_school = o."School Name" GROUP BY o."School Name", o."Applications Expected" HAVING COUNT(b.applicant) < o."Applications Expected" / 2.0 ORDER BY o."School Name"

```sql
WITH fuzzy_matches AS (
  SELECT
    o."School Name" AS school_name,
    a."School" AS application_school,
    jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(o."School Name")), lower(trim(a."School"))) AS similarity_score
  FROM "lpf_outreach" o
  JOIN "lpf_applications" a ON a."Status" = 'Submitted'
  WHERE jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(o."School Name")), lower(trim(a."School"))) >= 0.9
),
school_stats AS (
  SELECT
    school_name,
    SUM("Students Reached") AS total_students_reached,
    SUM("Applications Expected") AS total_applications_expected,
    COUNT(DISTINCT application_school) AS distinct_applications_received
  FROM fuzzy_matches
  GROUP BY school_name
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  total_applications_expected,
  distinct_applications_received,
  total_applications_expected / 2.0 AS half_expected_applications
FROM school_stats
WHERE distinct_applications_received < NULLIF(total_applications_expected / 2.0, 0)
ORDER BY school_name;
```
